## Description

Write one concise, factual sentence explaining what the tool does. Avoid rankings,
valuation claims, user-count claims, and vendor slogans.

## Why this belongs

Explain what makes the tool useful or distinct from entries already in the catalog.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] The tool is publicly reachable.
- [ ] It appears actively maintained.
- [ ] It adds meaningful functionality or coverage.
- [ ] It is not already present in `catalog/tools/`.
- [ ] The official URL has been checked.
